toolchain.selection_reason: Pinned patched stable release; Lean 4.32.1 includes the July 2026 kernel soundness fix documented by the Lean project.

project.build_command: Set ELAN_HOME to the isolated project toolchain, then run lake build in formal/lean

checked_modules.scope: Typed total-function identity, composition, associativity, and endomap-only powers
Exact two-state constant-lift expansion plus separately declared literal matrix/Gram and 2-versus-1 arithmetic fixtures. Generic matrix/Gram/trace/rank definitions and bridge lemmas are not present.

A_id=I entrywise and on basis vectors; typed composition on basis vectors; zero/one entry characterizations; and exact relational-product support composition. Finite-sum numerical matrix multiplication and arbitrary-vector linearity are not modeled.
Four-atom ACBE/RPM exhaustiveness, proper global pieces, transverse refinement, and global witness-map separation

open_formalization_obligations: Universal deterministic-lift operator-norm theorem over finite-dimensional real or complex Hilbert spaces
Full presheaf and sheaf-condition formalization on all sixteen context objects
Generation of Grothendieck topologies from the two cover bases
Product-site comparison and legacy round-trip equivalence
Fixed-order shortlex leastness for the executable closure algorithm
Finite-sum numerical matrix multiplication and arbitrary-vector linear extension of the formally checked lift basis laws
Bridge from the constantTwoLift function to generic matrix, Gram, trace, and rank definitions

validation_snapshot.note: The two exhaustiveness proofs use Lean's standard propositional extensionality axiom through simplification; the other fourteen audited theorem dependencies are axiom-free.

claim_boundary: A successful Lean build kernel-checks only the stated modules. Identity and composition of the deterministic lift are formal at the entry, basis-action, and relational-support levels; finite-sum numerical matrix multiplication and arbitrary-vector linearity remain open. The exact counterexample function is formal; the literal matrix/Gram and 2-versus-1 fixtures are not yet bridged to generic trace/rank definitions. The seed declares no project-specific axioms or sorry, while two finite-set equality proofs use standard propext. It is not independent peer review, empirical validation, a completed Noetic Topos 2.0 proof, or a product-claim license.
